mechanism: Hub of human-curated reusable agent-computer interfaces plus a structured experiment log
evidence_scope: we instantiate human experience as a repository of reusable ACIs, named AutoTrainHub, that provide the agent with structured guidance for conducting iterative post-training.
evidence_role: We introduce AutoTrainess, an LM agent empowered by a training-specialized ACIs that enables autonomous end-to-end LLM post-training.
